Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Guarantee/Warranty: The materials will be covered by manufacturer’s warranty and the supplier will b e responsible for any defects in their supplied products including the noncompliance of basic characteristic s as per contract. Warranty Replacement: - The Manufacturer shall submit an undertaking that the materials will be repla ced free of cost in case it is found of sub-standard quality within 10 days of receipt of intimation. 2. The bidder shall make sure that delivery of cylinders should be within spec ified range. 4. The inspection and acceptance of industrial gases supplied shall be done at consignee end. 5. Other charges, like loss of cylinder, its repair component cost & rental charges are as under: In case of any loss/damage to cylinder/valve/Spare parts, the following charges (maximum) will be applica ble- a) Replacement cost of cylinder if lost or damaged: ₹ 10500 + GST @ 18% b) Cylinder Valve: ₹ 780 + GST @ 18% c) Cylinder Cap: ₹ 330 + GST @ 18% d) Spindle: ₹ 150 + GST @ 18% e) Gland Nut: ₹ 150 + GST @ 18% f) Safety Guard Plug: ₹ 150 + GST @ 18% g) Washer: ₹ 150 + GST @ 18% h) Cylinder Rent per day beyond 15 days: ₹ 3 + GST @ 18% 6. Cylinder not returned within 90 days shall be considered as lost. 7. All other terms and conditions will be as per our company norms. 8. Any dispute howsoever arising out of contract will have jurisdiction of court at Ranchi, Jharkhand only. . 8. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification.
